notes.title: Improvement Patch Released! & Reviews exceed 100!
notes.content:
■Improvement patch now available. Thank you for over 100 reviews!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451542/c92bd9f807cad3b8d838c07772e920a5c8b1470b.jpg"]



Thank you for your continued support of “Holo's Hanafuda”!

Since release, we've been incredibly grateful to see so many people playing the game and receiving your supportive messages and suggestions for improvement.

Your reviews, community hub posts, livestreams, and social media shares have been a tremendous encouragement to the entire development team.



We have now released the following improvement patch:



・Added an option to skip a losing match in Adventure Mode.

・Added an option to adjust the text display speed in Adventure Mode.

・Added penalty functionality when disconnecting in the middle of an online match.



Lastly, the first DLC is currently 10% OFF for a limited time, so please consider purchasing it if you're interested.

notes.title: Opening video now available! Release date, time, and price also announced.
notes.content:
■Holo's Hanafuda opening revealed!

[previewyoutube="wCe3aW-GN-M;full"][/previewyoutube]
Fubuki Shirakami, Ayame Nakiri, Mio Oogami, and Sakura Miko

Choco Yuzuki and Lui Takamine are making a big splash in a stop-motion animation!

Please check out the cute and lively hololive members in action! ✨

The stop-motion animation was produced by STUDIO UGAJIN, who served as director of photography for the Netflix series “My Melody & Kuromi.” 🎥
